items.title: Boeing Is Down 37% From Its High, and Its Jet Unit Is in an “Overstaffed Position.” Is the Selling Overdone?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBoeing just hit a fresh 52-week low, 37% below its January high, because its 737 production ramp keeps slipping and its cash targets keep moving to later years. A 5% cut to its jet workforce and lower October deliveries show the slower ramp is real, and it also matters for engine maker GE Aerospace and for Southwest Airlines, which flies only 737s.

items.title: Boeing Is 36% Below Its High. A Director Who Was CFO of United Technologies Just Bought $500,000 of Stock
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBoeing (BA:NYSE) director Akhil Johri bought 3,000 shares for $500,067 on Nov. 17, with the stock 36% below its January high.
